summary: Evacuation of more than 140 students from the Mt Evans Outdoor Lab after its access road washed out
location: Mt Evans Outdoor Lab, near Mt Evans
notes: Alpine responded with ATVs and POVs; members reached the school after a snowplow cleared a rockslide on Hwy 103 from the concurrent Chicago Lake mudslide rescue (id 1852). Victim count recorded as 140 per the report's "more than 140 students".
